info.title: Nodbusiness API
info.description: Generated from the route sources by backend/scripts/generate-api-docs.js (npm run docs:api). Lists every endpoint with its method, path parameters, sign-in requirement (x-auth: public, optional, auth, admin) and the standard error responses. Request and response bodies are not described yet; see the route source named in x-source. Every response carries the header API-Version: 1.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, TOKEN_EXPIRED, NOT_FOUND.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-ID header; quote it when reporting a problem.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the token is invalid, expired or revoked.

Forbidden.description: Signed in but not allowed (for example ADMIN_REQUIRED or MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED).

NotFound.description: Not found (also returned for malformed ids).

ValidationError.description: The request body or query failed validation.
